jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build a career where every day brings new challenges, hands\-on learning, and meaningful environmental work? Provost \& Pritchard is seeking a motivated **Field Technician** to join our Environmental team.

  



You will spend most of your time in the field collecting samples, supporting drilling and well installations, and collaborating with engineers, scientists, contractors, and clients. You will also build technical skills through data analysis, reporting, mapping, and project coordination.

  



If you enjoy working outdoors, solving problems, learning by doing, and contributing to work that matters, we’d like to hear from you.

  


**What You’ll Do:**


* Collect soil, soil vapor, indoor air, groundwater, surface water, and other environmental samples.
* Conduct aquifer and pump testing, drilling oversight, and soil logging in support of monitoring well projects, including monitoring well installation, development, purging, and sampling.
* Maintain clear, accurate field notes, sampling logs, forms, and project documentation.
* Coordinate with drillers, surveyors, equipment operators, laboratories, landowners, regulatory agencies, subcontractors, and clients.
* Assist with environmental investigations at contaminated or hazardous sites, including inspections, data collection, and technical support.
* Organize data for reports, spreadsheets, databases, maps, graphs, and cross sections.
* Support permitting and regulatory compliance activities, including work involving California Well Standards and agencies such as Regional Water Quality Control Board (RWQCB) and Department of Toxic Substances Control (DTSC).
* Help coordinate subconsultants, requests for proposals, schedules, and field activities.
* Contribute to projects that meet established scopes, schedules, budgets, quality standards, and safety requirements.

  


**Qualifications:**


* A high school diploma or GED is required; an Associate or Bachelor’s degree in geology, engineering, environmental science, or a related field is preferred.
* Interest in environmental investigation, remediation, and field\-based work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to prepare accurate field documentation and technical records.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and comfort learning databases and other technical software.
* A detail\-oriented, dependable approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Sound judgment, professionalism, and a commitment to safety.

  


**Certifications:**


* OSHA 40\-Hour HAZWOPER certification is preferred but not required.

  


**What to Expect**



This is an active, hands\-on position with approximately **70% fieldwork and 30% office\-based support**. You will work outdoors in changing weather conditions and may travel or work early mornings, evenings, weekends, or extended hours depending on project needs.

  

Candidates must be able to lift and move up to 50 pounds and perform field activities that may involve standing, walking, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, working near water, and wearing Level D personal protective equipment.

Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is actively seeking a highly motivated Environmental Scientist to join our Environmental Remediation group in Denver, CO or Ft. Collins. We are seeking a candidate who is an excellent communicator and technically capable, with an awareness of relevant regulations. The successful candidate will work under the oversight of an experienced team of engineers and scientists on environmental site assessments, remedial and solid waste design and construction, and environmental support on multi\-disciplinary projects. This position will involve field and office responsibilities with potential for growth.


The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

* Performs standard scientific work requiring application of techniques and procedures.
* Detect problems when using standardized procedures because of the condition of sample, difficulties with the equipment, etc.
* Conducts specific phases of projects for more experienced scientists.
* Proposes appropriate analytical methods and techniques. Assists in providing advice and consulting services within scope of scientific knowledge.
* Draw conclusions and makes recommendations based on analysis.
* Interprets and records data, conducts analyses, compares findings to relevant studies and local, state and federal regulations to ensure compliance.
* Works under general supervision.
* Mentors and leader to more junior staff.
* Lead teams of staff in carrying out project specific work and field work.
* Flexible with working extended hours and locations, travel may be greater than 50 percent of time, however within 1 to 2 hours of Ft. Collins, Denver, and/or Greeley.
* Must be able to do day travel regionally.

  

**Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in environmental sciences or engineering or other related fields, AND 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and education.
* Valid driver's license and ability to pass MVR
* Subject to a pre\-employment Background check.
* Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre\-employment substance abuse test.
* Due to some of the sites, US Citizenship or a permanent resident is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree preferred and/or 10\+ years of relevant experience.
* Professional Geologist or Professional Engineer License.
* Upstream oil and gas experience.
* Willingness and ability to work outdoors in sometimes challenging conditions.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills, comfortable liaising with clients, colleagues and sub\-contractors alike.
* Willingness and ability to learn and rapidly master new tasks.
* Scientific research and report writing (including web\-based research).
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Excellent written and verbal skills.
* Strong quality and time management.
* Self\-starter, develops and delivers work under own initiative.
* Solid attention to detail and thorough approach to work.
* Seeking professional certifications.
* 40hr OSHA HAZWOPER certificate.
* Microsoft Office, AutoCADD, GIS applications.

  

**Additional Information**  

* No sponsorship is available for this role
* No relocation is available for this role.

jobs.title: Staff Geologist/Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

NV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public and private sector clients, delivering solutions through six business verticals: Testing, Inspection \& Consulting; Infrastructure; Utility Services; Environmental Health Sciences; Buildings \& Program Management; and Geospatial Technology. With offices nationwide and abroad, NV5 helps clients plan, design, build, test, certify, and operate projects that improve the communities where we live and work.  

As engineers, architects, construction/program managers, environmental professionals and beyond, we play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team focused on *Delivering Solutions and Improving Lives*.  

We’re seeking a motivated **Staff Geologist/Engineer** to join our team and play a key role in supporting our Project Managers, Engineers, and Geologists on a variety of exciting field and construction projects.  

In this hands\-on role, you’ll assist with **site investigations, construction observations, drilling operations, borings, test excavations, field data collection, and technical report preparation**. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting out in the field, building technical expertise, and contributing to projects from investigation through completion.  

The ideal candidate is comfortable working outdoors and should be prepared to spend up to 10 hours per day in the field. Responsibilities may include operating a nuclear density gauge and working with moisture\-density testing equipment as part of quality assurance and construction monitoring activities.  

We offer a **flexible hybrid work environment**, with opportunities to work in the **field, office, and remotely from home**. Join a collaborative team that values professional development, career advancement, and investing in your long\-term success. **What we offer:*** Flexible hybrid schedule (field, office, and remote work)
* Great benefits package
* Opportunities for career growth and mentorship
* Diverse, hands\-on project experience
* A supportive and collaborative team environment


If you’re looking to grow your career in geotechnical consulting and enjoy a balance of fieldwork, technical challenges, and teamwork, we’d love to hear from you!  


Responsibilities:
* The position includes performing geotechnical field exploration.
* Writing daily field reports and maintaining exploration logs.
* Performing laboratory testing.
* Candidates will be part of a team that conducts geotechnical analysis and prepares engineering reports and project deliverables.
* The team observes construction to ensure compliance with design documents.
* **This role is 80\-90% field exploration/investigations and 10\-20% technical review, writing, and reporting.**


Qualifications:
* BS in Geology or Engineering; a Master's in Geotechnical Engineering is a plus
* 0\-3 years of experience
* Must be able to work in all weather climates, as this role is largely in the field
* GIT is a plus
* Must be able to lift, carry, and pull up to 50lbs of equipment.
* Must have a valid driver's license
* Passion for learning, flexible to work an ever\-changing schedule per construction requests.

**The pay range for this position in Oregon is $30\.00 \-$35\.00 per hour**. Base pay offered may be higher or lower depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location of the candidate. Restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.  

All local employment laws apply. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via the NV5 careers site.
